name: Tiberias
overview: The Scriptures identify Tiberias as both a city located on the shore of Lake Galilee and a name associated with the lake itself, referred to as the sea of Tiberias. Jesus ministered in this region, crossing the sea of Galilee and appearing to His disciples by the sea of Tiberias after His resurrection, highlighting the area's significance in His earthly ministry. The presence of boats from Tiberias during Jesus' feeding of the five thousand further emphasizes the city's role as a vibrant community adjacent to this important body of water.
